robot: Marvin bimanual robot: two 7-joint arms with parallel two-finger grippers at a table (RoboWits on Genesis)

frame.suite: RoboWits world frame: the robot base at (0, 0, 1.08), x away from the robot, y to its left, z up
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: the robot's base point (1.08 m above the world origin), +X away from the robot towards the table, +Y to the robot's left, +Z up

right.note: 7 joints (Joint1_R..Joint7_R, rad; the wrist joints are limited to about +-60 deg); end-effector pose = the gripper tip frame Gripper_Tip_R (+z approach, +x the finger-closing direction)

ee.point: the gripper tip (Gripper_Tip_R: +z approach, +x finger-closing direction)
ee.mode_text: the service solves each pose by inverse kinematics (no collision checking) and drives the arm there in joint space (duration_s does not apply); an arm whose IK fails holds and is reported

left.note: 7 joints (Joint1_L..Joint7_L, rad; the wrist joints are limited to about +-60 deg); end-effector pose = the gripper tip frame Gripper_Tip_L (+z approach, +x the finger-closing direction)

ee.point: the gripper tip (Gripper_Tip_L: +z approach, +x finger-closing direction)
ee.mode_text: the service solves each pose by inverse kinematics (no collision checking) and drives the arm there in joint space (duration_s does not apply); an arm whose IK fails holds and is reported

notes: The gripper value in the state is the commanded opening width (0.1 m = open, 0 = closed); gripper_opening_m is the measured opening (a gripper closed on an object stops above 0). The wrist joints are limited to about +-60 deg, so a vertical approach works only for finger-closing directions within about 60 deg of the +Y axis. Joint efforts (Joint1_R_effort ...) in proprio_now rise when an arm pushes on something. The episode ends by itself once the goal holds with the graded objects released and at rest through a short settle window.
